title: Customs House Museum

services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: The Customs House Museum & Cultural Center is where history, art and culture inspire a diverse community. The Customs House Museum & Cultural Center has spaces to accommodate a wide variety of events. The museum is a premier location to host bridal luncheons, baby showers, birthday parties, retirement dinners, small wedding receptions, or business seminars. From intimate gatherings to a full theatre setting, the Customs House Museum offers a unique atmosphere in historic Downtown Clarksville,
